import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap;
        long cost;
        Edge rev;
        Edge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        FlowNetwork(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            Edge e1 = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost);
            e1.rev = e2;
            e2.rev = e1;
            adj.get(src).add(e1);
            adj.get(dst).add(e2);
        }

        List<List<Edge>> getAdj() {
            return adj;
        }

        int size() {
            return adj.size();
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        FlowNetwork network;
        long minCost;
        long totalCost;
        long[] supply;
        long[] potential;

        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            network = new FlowNetwork(n);
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supply = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
        }

        void addSupply(int node, long vol) {
            supply[node] += vol;
        }

        boolean flow() {
            int n = network.size();
            boolean augmented;
            do {
                augmented = false;
                long[] dist = new long[n];
                Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                Edge[] last = new Edge[n];
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (supply[i] > 0) {
                        dist[i] = 0;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{0, i});
                    }
                }
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] cur = pq.poll();
                    long d = cur[0];
                    int u = (int) cur[1];
                    if (d > dist[u]) continue;
                    for (Edge e : network.getAdj().get(u)) {
                        if (e.cap > 0) {
                            long nd = d + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.dst];
                            if (nd < dist[e.dst]) {
                                dist[e.dst] = nd;
                                last[e.dst] = e;
                                pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.dst});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                        potential[i] += dist[i];
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (supply[i] < 0 && last[i] != null) {
                        long flowAmount = -supply[i];
                        int v = i;
                        while (last[v] != null) {
                            flowAmount = Math.min(flowAmount, last[v].cap);
                            v = last[v].src;
                        }
                        v = i;
                        while (last[v] != null) {
                            last[v].cap -= flowAmount;
                            last[v].rev.cap += flowAmount;
                            v = last[v].src;
                        }
                        supply[v] -= flowAmount;
                        supply[i] += flowAmount;
                        minCost += flowAmount * potential[i];
                        augmented = true;
                    }
                }
            } while (augmented);
            for (long s : supply) {
                if (s > 0) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        long getMinCost() {
            if (flow()) {
                return minCost;
            } else {
                throw new RuntimeException("Flow not feasible");
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int T_LIMIT = 105;
        int totalNodes = 6100;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(totalNodes);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) - 1;
            mcf.addSupply(j, 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < T_LIMIT; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.network.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.network.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T_LIMIT; t++) {
                mcf.network.addEdge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }

        int dst = totalNodes - 1;
        mcf.addSupply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= T_LIMIT; t++) {
            mcf.network.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }

        System.out.println(mcf.getMinCost());
    }
}
